name: Ureshiko
source:
Picked up by the protagonist and Miyuki on the roadside. She is the ace of "Moss Agate" a group that has become part of the resistance. She is able to pull out the capabilities of any aircraft by up to 3 times, and always achieves great results. She is one of the strongest forces for humanity.

Every once in a while, she returns from the frontlines against the machines. She is kind to Miyuki and harsh towards the protagonist. This is due to her parental love and fondness for girls. She understands herself that the feelings she has are sometimes for the protagonist. She holds a grudge against the protagonist as she realizes he is the love of her life. This is because she has never been in love and focused on training in the military.

She is thorough and only uses analog devices. She ignores radars and sensors, and prefers to use her intuition to achieve battle results.
